purpose: Teach: 臨時/外側/民生/自前/和風/出会える/全般/丁度

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、臨時、絶対、バイト、絶対、始めたんだって?本気で
lines.en: Riku — you actually got a temp job? Seriously?
lines.style: Bright, direct opener with a lift of surprise. Quick pace, genuine curiosity underneath the casual tone. A beat of pause before the question mark, like she's checking if she heard right.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。校舎の、本気で、絶対、外側、絶対、塗装、絶対、業者が、絶対、来てたぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. The painting contractors were out at the school building the other day.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded. Easy confidence — he's not bragging, just answering. Steady pacing. He meets her question halfway, no performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お父さんの会社、本気で、絶対、民生、絶対、製品、絶対、扱ってるんだよね、リク
lines.en: Your dad's company deals with consumer products, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting dots out loud. Slower pace — she's genuinely thinking through something. Warm tone, like she's building on what he said, not testing him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、本気で、絶対、俺たち、絶対、自前、絶対、の衣装、絶対、作るぜ、桜
lines.en: We're making our own costumes for the culture festival.
lines.style: A little more animated now. Pride edging in beneath the casual statement. Slight emphasis on 'our' — inclusion matters. Still grounded, but with forward momentum.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、和風、絶対、お料理、絶対、お土産に、絶対、もらったよ、リク
lines.en: I got some of Grandma's homemade Japanese food to take as a gift.
lines.style: Light, almost conversational aside. A small smile in the voice. Warm memory of it. The pace stays easy — she's sharing, not performing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、ともだち、絶対、出会える、絶対、よな、桜
lines.en: You get to meet new friends on the school trip, you know?
lines.style: Optimistic, open-ended. He's sharing something he's thought about, not pushing. Gentle pace. The trailing tone suggests he's imagining the possibilities himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、本気で、絶対、全般、絶対、お前、絶対、頑張ってるよね、リク
lines.en: You're really working hard at everything you do, aren't you?
lines.style: Genuine warmth without exaggeration. Not condescending — she's noticing something real. Steady, sincere delivery. A moment of real seeing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前と、本気で、絶対、丁度、絶対、家、絶対、近いから、絶対、一緒に帰ろうぜ、桜
lines.en: Since we live pretty close, why don't we walk home together?
lines.style: Soft, easy invitation. No pressure, just genuine. Warm baseline. Slight intimacy in the simplicity — he's offering something small and real.
